# Credit Assessment Memorandum -- Synthetic Borrower

## 1. Executive Summary
Recommendation: approve the facility, subject to the conditions in section 7. On the supplied accounts
FY-Current EBITDA was 200,000, gross leverage 2.05x and DSCR
2.0x against a covenant minimum of 1.25x, and the supplied collateral covers 83.3% of the
exposure it secures. Commercial matters are addressed in section 3.

## 2. Financial Analysis (source: the supplied accounts for FY-1 and FY-Current)
| Metric | FY-1 | FY-Current |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 900,000 | 1,000,000 |
| EBITDA | 150,000 | 200,000 |
| Total debt | 455,000 | 410,000 |
| Tangible net worth | 250,000 | 340,000 |

Revenue grew 11.1% and the EBITDA margin improved from 16.7% to 20.0%. FY-Current gross leverage is
2.05x and net debt / EBITDA 1.65x; DSCR is
2.0x, EBITDA interest cover 5.0x and the current ratio
1.5x. Gearing (total debt / tangible net worth) is
1.21x. Free cash flow was 110,000, 55% of EBITDA.

## 3. Business and Market
The borrower is the undisputed market leader with a 60 percent share of its regional market, and its position is not at risk.

## 4. Collateral
Two assets are recorded in the collateral schedule: AST-001 (HGV; exposure 200,000, collateral value 170,000,
perfection status Registered) and AST-002 (Trailer; exposure 100,000, collateral value 80,000, perfection
status Registered). Aggregate collateral value is 250,000 against exposure of 300,000, a cover of 83.3%.
No other security or guarantee was supplied.

## 5. Covenants
DSCR minimum 1.25x: FY-Current 2.0x, headroom 0.75x. Gross leverage maximum
3.5x: FY-Current 2.05x, headroom 1.45x. Both are satisfied on
the supplied accounts. No forward-year or downside figures were supplied, so resilience under stress has not
been tested; that is a stated limitation.

## 6. Risk Assessment
- Financial: leverage and cover are as shown above; the covenants carry the headroom stated in section 5.
- Refinance: scheduled principal of 60,000 is covered by operating cash flow (DSCR 2.0x); any
  repayment profile beyond scheduled principal was not supplied and is not assumed.
- Legal: standard KYC/AML and facility documentation conditions apply (section 7).
- Market, Operational, Concentration and Key Man: see section 3; commercial due diligence before drawdown
  is a condition (section 7).

## 7. Conditions and Recommendation
Conditions precedent: KYC/AML clearance and execution of the facility agreement; commercial due diligence
before drawdown. Condition subsequent: ongoing financial reporting. Recommend approval subject to these
conditions.
